offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures wood-to-wood, wood-to-concrete and masonry connectors, fasteners, anchors, and lateral systems for residential and commercial construction. Sells mainly through building materials distributors and home centers to builders, contractors and engineers.

primary_products.value: structural connectors; anchors and adhesives; fasteners; fastening tools; lateral force-resisting systems

primary_services.value: engineering support and design software; training; testing

customer_segment.value: B2B: homebuilders, contractors, engineers, architects, building material dealers and distributors

end_markets.value: residential construction; commercial construction; infrastructure; repair and remodeling

revenue_model.value: product sales: connectors, anchors, fasteners and related building products

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes connectors and anchors from steel and other purchased materials, sold to dealers, distributors and builders

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: connectors, anchors, fasteners, tools and lateral systems for construction

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: building material dealers and wholesale distributors; third-party retail: home centers; direct sales: large builders and contractors
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: products must meet building codes and code evaluation approvals such as ICC-ES, environmental and safety rules
